checks.name: D1 a stranger cannot delete someone else's meet (MEET_NOT_HOST)
D2 the host deletes an empty meet → {deleted:true}
D3 read back: meets/show of the deleted meet → NO_SUCH_MEET (L6)
D4 its native chat room is gone too
D5 a meet with a player on it → MEET_HAS_PARTICIPANTS (cancel instead)
D6 …and it still exists with its player (nothing half-deleted)
D7 a meet with a match → MEET_HAS_MATCHES
R0 planted: the confirmed player left the room natively (not a member any more)
R1 a player cannot refresh the meet chat (MEET_NOT_HOST)
R2 the host refreshes: {added>=1} and the player is back in the room (read back)
R3 a second refresh adds nobody (idempotent)
P1 a confirmed player asks for a +1 afterwards → the guest row exists (read back)
P2 a second +1 → MEET_GUEST_LIMIT
P3 planted: a plain re-join by a confirmed player is still refused (MEET_ALREADY_PARTICIPANT)
B1 the viewer the host blocked reads hostBlockedMe=true before tapping Join
B2 another viewer reads hostBlockedMe=false
B3 …and the engine still refuses the blocked viewer's join (MEET_BLOCKED)
B4 planted: after the unblock hostBlockedMe reads false again
C1 the declined invitee is on the roster as declined (Can't go), read back
C2 …and holds no seat: confirmed / spotsLeft unchanged
F1 the host sets a per-meet skill override and reads it back (forceSkill 4.5)
F2 a player may not set it (MEET_NOT_HOST)
N1 a club named with the brand → CLUB_NAME_RESERVED
N2 …spacing and case do not get round it
N3 planted: a plain name still creates (the rule is not a wall)
N4 a rename into the brand is refused
I1 the invited player sees the club in clubs/invitations/mine
I2 another player does not (only their own invitations)
I3 planted: after the admin cancels, it is gone from the list
V1 a club member reads who voted: choice B lists mei (read back)
V2 a non-member → CLUB_NOT_MEMBER (the voters stay in the club)
V3 a poll outside any club → CLUB_NO_SUCH_NOTE (Misskey's own polls stay private)
